authority: User explicitly requires the same patient partitions and holdout as the current study, with each method using its original-paper network inputs. This supersedes the earlier preferred common-three-phase-ROI adaptation plan.
primary_comparison: Original-paper method inputs and architecture on our frozen patient partitions; not exact replication of the original article cohort or reported scores.

partitions.dataset: registered_roi32_medium976_v1 membership only; source image representations differ by method
partitions.train_eligibility: Honor fixed assignments. If the native method cannot train on missing-input patients, report actual eligible training/validation denominators and exclusions; do not reassign patients across partitions.

method_native_contract_required: MRI acquisition phase selection and phase timing
derived image formulas, units, denominator handling and clipping
2D/3D representation, MIP axes and field of view
voxel spacing, crop dimensions, interpolation and localization rules
contemporaneous segmentation/habitat/geometry definitions and annotation source
original clinical variables and modality set
original observed visit combination and decision time
self-supervised/pretraining objectives and use of training pCR labels
training recipe and validation-only checkpoint rule
preprocessing_fit: Retain each article preprocessing algorithm. Fit any data-dependent image/clinical normalization, imputation, feature selection and resampling target on the appropriate training partition; do not reuse article cohort-specific fitted means solely because printed in the paper, or fit on heldout patients.
representation_policy: Create method-specific derived datasets from version-matched source images. Existing three-phase ROI32 is not a universal baseline input and should only be reused when the original method contract is demonstrably identical.
timepoint_policy: Compare in the same clinical decision-time panel only when the original method supports that observed-input set. Preserve native visit combinations; no forced prefix conversion for the primary comparison. T3-dependent classification is a later-information reference, not an early T0/T1/T2 competitor.
missing_required_input: Try to obtain and audit required source inputs first. Apply only a documented native missing-input policy when appropriate. Otherwise mark the fixed-cohort native reproduction blocked/not feasible; do not silently drop test patients, substitute masks/modalities, or invent zero-padding.

evaluation.probabilities: Mean the five fold-model probabilities separately for every heldout patient and native decision point, then compute metrics.
evaluation.author_validation_threshold: Additional operating-point analysis if specified by source paper; select on validation only and report separately.
evaluation.metrics: Existing common 14 metrics plus paired patient intervals and comparisons at matched decision times.
evaluation.macro: T0/T1/T2 Macro only for methods natively supporting all three decision points; otherwise NA, not copied or synthesized.
evaluation.new_comparison_multiplicity: Specify appropriate new comparison families before inspecting added-model results.

input_information_reporting: Different native modalities, clinical covariates, masks, FOV, pretraining supervision and decision times must be explicit in tables; this measures complete methods under their native inputs rather than isolating architecture alone.
code_fixes: Repair objective implementation defects (cross-patient attention, patient-split leakage, selecting checkpoints on test, dropped evaluation patients) against article intent, and document paper-code discrepancies. No undocumented architecture/input simplification.
separate_secondary_experiments: Common-input adaptations or added clinical features are optional separate controls; never presented as faithful native-input reproductions.
geometry: Before any new image/mask reconstruction: preserve version-matched native metadata, mask header, registered geometry, phase/longitudinal transforms and crop mappings; no corrected public JSON combined with incompatible old masks. Original data are preserved.
